name: Asking
overview: Scripture teaches that asking is a vital expression of dependence on God and others, encompassing requests for forgiveness, help, provision, prayer, and permission. Jesus encourages believers to ask persistently and with faith, promising that those who ask will receive, seek will find, and knock will have doors opened (Matthew 7:7; Luke 11:8). However, James warns that unanswered requests often stem from asking with wrong motives, seeking selfish desires rather than God's will (James 4:2-3). Ultimately, trusting in God's power and submitting to His perfect will is foundational, as He is able to do all things according to His wisdom (Jeremiah 32:27; Romans 12:2).
